sections.text:
In a colorful tropical forest, there was a very proud peacock with its beautiful, shiny feathers, which contained a rainbow of colors of blue, green and gold.

The peacock spent all day showing off and strutting in front of other animals, opening his tail like a big fan and saying: “Look at my beauty! There is no bird in existence that has such luxurious feathers as I do!”

One day, the peacock met a crane with long legs and dull gray feathers devoid of any bright colors.

The peacock looked at the crane with mockery and disgust and said: “Oh, what a miserable bird you are! Your feathers are grey, so ugly and dull, they look as if they are covered with dust, while my feathers are like the clothes of kings studded with precious jewels!”

The crane initially ignored the peacock's sarcasm, but the peacock continued to brag and belittle him.

Finally, the crane looked at the peacock calmly and wisely, and said: “It is true that your feathers are beautiful and colorful like jewels, and that my feathers are gray and simple and do not attract attention, but...

".

Then the crane suddenly spread its broad and strong wings, beat the air with them forcefully, and flew high into the clear blue sky, until it became close to the clouds and stars!
The crane called from the sky in a loud voice to the peacock, which remained standing on the ground: “I can fly with these pale feathers until I touch the clouds and see the whole world from above! While you, with your heavy and luxurious royal feathers, cannot rise more than a few meters above the ground and remain trapped in the dust like a chicken!”

The arrogant peacock felt extremely embarrassed and deeply ashamed, and realized that external beauty is not everything, and that every creature has its own advantage and abilities that make it unique, and that beautiful feathers are of no use if they prevent you from flying freely.
